4.column:
Monday morning, one game left, and four of you are tied at 11–4: Dan, Devin, Nate V and Thom. Andy R, Josh, Mike Sombloski and Peggy sit at 10–5 and need help. Everyone else is out, the commissioner included, stuck at 9–6 with the people he told "Y'all suck." Brandon Goes Commando skipped Thursday and London and still went 8–5. Mrs. Sombloski filed mid-Sunday and is 4–1, the best percentage in the building.

Falcons at Saints locks at 8:15 tonight. If it doesn't break the tie, the tiebreaker will.
